name: analyze-and-summarize
description: Analyze the repository for a question, in parallel summarize any provided notes, then merge both into one reviewed answer.

inputs.name: question
inputs.description: What to find out about the repository

inputs.name: notes
inputs.description: Free-form notes to fold into the answer

nodes.task: Answer this question about the repository you are in: {{inputs.question}}

{{inputs.notes}}
